govWatch.line: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Night Court is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
📺 Amélia killed Night Court out past the ridge — alone — and walked home. 6 rounds, 54 taken. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
🌾 Emberhold's tribute comes up thin — 1,940 of 4,000 kcal. They sent everything the wagons could carry, and it wasn't enough. The shortfall rides as arrears (+2,060 kcal). (Trust -1.)

Three fires bow to Haven. But a realm isn't leverage — it's seasons. These bonds are young; tend them, keep the trust, and the court will come.
